All variants in a first name's family

Source: R/nicknames.R
first_name_variants.Rd

Lists every name that shares the canonical form of x (see nickname_lookup() for the rule), and how each one gets there: spellings, misspellings and nicknames of that canonical name. It also lists, with in_canonical = FALSE, names that are related but are not merged into the canonical form: unreviewed sound-alike spellings, cognates (JOSE for JOSEPH), compound names (MARYANN), and nicknames that are ambiguous between this name and another (KATHY between KATHLEEN and KATHERINE).

Usage

first_name_variants(
  x,
  gender = "U",
  related = TRUE,
  min_freq = 0,
  min_share = 0.6,
  min_nick_rate = 0.002,
  spelling = c("lexicon", "misspelling")
)

Arguments

x

A first name (a single string; case is ignored).

gender

"U" (default), "M" or "F". Gender can change the canonical form of a nickname (PAT) and so the family.

related

Logical; include the related names that are not merged (in_canonical = FALSE). Defaults to TRUE.

min_freq

Drop names with fewer national Part VII records than this (most misspellings are rare). Defaults to 0 (keep all).

min_share

Share of the nickname evidence the top formal name needs. Defaults to 0.6.

min_nick_rate

Minimum ratio of people carrying the name as a nickname (people with the name and a formal form) to national records with the name, for the name to be resolved. Defaults to 0.002.

spelling

Which spelling pairs define spelling roots: any of "lexicon" (reviewed spelling pairs), "misspelling" (rare forms of common names), "sound_alike" (unreviewed sound-alike pairs). Defaults to c("lexicon", "misspelling").

Value

A data.frame, one row per name, with columns name, canonical, relation (canonical, spelling, misspelling, sound_alike, nickname, ambiguous nickname, cognate, compound), via (the name it connects through, for a spelling step or a nickname step), in_canonical, freq (national Part VII records with the name) and share_female. Merged names come first, most common first.

Examples

first_name_variants("kate", min_freq = 1000)
